overview: This paper proposes Multistep Quasimetric Estimation (MQE), an offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning method that combines multistep Monte-Carlo returns with quasimetric architectures to enable long-horizon stitching and compositional generalization in simulated and real-world robotic tasks.

modules.name: Quasimetric Network Architecture (MRN)
modules.description: Implements the Metric Residual Network (MRN) parameterization. Takes two latent embeddings as input and outputs a scalar distance value, enforcing non-negativity, identity, and the triangle inequality properties of a quasimetric space.

modules.name: State and State-Action Representation Encoders
modules.description: Constructs the encoders for mapping raw observations and state-action pairs into the latent space required by the MRN. Supports both MLP architectures for state-based inputs and Impala-style CNNs for visual inputs.

modules.name: Offline Data Sampling and Waypoint Generation
modules.description: Handles the data loading and sampling logic for offline trajectories. Generates goal states using a geometric distribution and samples intermediate waypoints using a combination of geometric and Bernoulli distributions to facilitate multistep backups.

modules.name: Multistep Distance Backup Loss
modules.description: Implements the multistep value propagation objective using Bregman divergence/LINEX loss. Calculates the loss between the current state-action distance to a goal and the waypoint's distance to the goal, adjusted by the temporal discount factor.

modules.name: Action Invariance Regularization
modules.description: Implements the loss function enforcing that the distance between a state and its corresponding state-action pair is zero. This bridges the value function and the Q-function, using a smooth formulation to prevent trivial convergence compared to standard regression.

modules.name: Goal-Conditioned Policy Extraction
modules.description: Implements the actor network and its optimization objective using DDPG+BC. Minimizes the quasimetric distance between the state-action pair produced by the policy and the goal, while regularizing the policy towards the behavior actions.

modules.name: MQE Agent Training Loop
modules.description: Orchestrates the complete training workflow. Iterates over the dataset, computes the multistep backup loss and action invariance loss for critic updates, and subsequently computes the policy extraction loss for actor updates.

modules.name: OGBench Benchmarking Suite
modules.description: Evaluates the trained policy on OGBench locomotion and manipulation tasks, including the custom colossal maze setups. Calculates the aggregate success rate across various tasks and dataset types (stitch, explore, etc.).

modules.name: BridgeData Real-World Evaluation
modules.description: Handles the inference and evaluation pipeline for real-world robotic manipulation on the Bridge setup. Measures task progress and binary success rates for compositional, long-horizon tasks like quadruple pick-and-place.

modules.name: Baseline Methods Integration
modules.description: Implements or integrates comparison algorithms such as GCIQL, HIQL, CRL, TMD, and n-SAC+BC. Provides standardized interfaces for training and evaluating these baselines under identical offline data conditions.

modules.name: Ablation Experiment Framework
modules.description: Configures and runs controlled experiments to validate design choices, such as comparing different waypoint sampling distributions, evaluating the necessity of the action invariance term versus expectile regression, and tuning geometric sampling hyperparameters.

modules.name: Distance Field Visualization
modules.description: Generates spatial heatmaps of the learned quasimetric distance between a fixed goal and all possible states in the environment. Used for qualitative assessment of value propagation structure and horizon generalization capabilities.
